newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent jumps on rumours of U.S. refinery proble.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent jumps on rumours of U.S. refinery proble.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures rose on Tuesday, jolted out of the rangebound lethargy that dogged it for most the session by rumours of problems at a U.S. refinery, brokers said.
IPE June Brent was 12 cents higher at $18.39 a barrel at 1514 GMT having clung to Monday's closing levels for most the session. May gas oil, meanwhile, was trading $2.50 up at $168.25 a tonne.
Traders attributed the jump higher to talk of a refinery problem and strength in the products markets. The refinery problem story had not yet been confirmed.
"It's been stuck in a narrow range for some time so it's not surprising to see it making a jump higher," one trader said. "I wouldn't expect to see it getting beyond $18.50."
